consoleHelp: The URL of your Executor organization’s integrations page. Used to open and manage imported accounts.
onYourBehalf: Paperclip will use {{provider}} on your behalf.
upstreamHelp: {{provider}} handles the connection and requests to {{app}}.
composioAppHelp: After connecting this account, sign in to the app in Composio.
gatewayAppHelp: Manage app sign-in in the provider, then refresh your gateway here.
bearerHelp: Paste the token only, without the word Bearer. It is kept in the connection’s credentials.
zapierInstruction1: Create an MCP server in Zapier and choose Other as the client.
zapierInstruction2: Connect your apps and select the actions to expose.
zapierInstruction3: Open Connect, generate a token, and copy the full server URL.
zapierPlaceholder: Paste the full URL from Zapier
zapierUrlHelp: The full server URL can contain a secret token. Paste it exactly as Zapier provides it.
zapierAuthHelp: For a separate token, use https://mcp.zapier.com/api/v1/connect and choose Bearer token.
arcadeInstruction1: Create a gateway in Arcade and select its tools.
arcadeInstruction2: Choose its User Source and copy the gateway URL.
arcadeInstruction3: Paste the URL here, then sign in when prompted.
arcadeUrlHelp: Copy the MCP gateway URL from Arcade. App authorization may be required the first time you use a tool.
arcadeAuthHelp: For Arcade Headers, use an API key as the bearer token and add the Arcade-User-ID header for the acting user.
composioInstruction1: Connect to Composio and sign in with your account.
composioInstruction2: Connect underlying apps in Composio when prompted.
composioUrlHelp: Paste the MCP URL from your existing Composio session. If it requires headers, add them under Change.
composioAuthHelp: Session URLs and headers come from your external Composio setup. Direct-tools sessions expose individual actions.
executorInstruction1: Connect your apps and configure action policies in Executor.
executorInstruction2: Open Integrations and copy the URL under “Connect an agent”.
executorInstruction3: Paste it here and sign in when prompted.
executorPlaceholder: Paste your Executor workspace MCP URL
executorUrlHelp: Use the hosted workspace URL or a self-hosted HTTP endpoint reachable from Paperclip. The server’s endpoint policy also applies.
executorAuthHelp: Keep any options in the copied URL. If using an API key, use a user key; workspace and organization keys cannot open an MCP session.
